newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index climbs 4.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index climbs 4.4 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 4.39 percent, or 3.53 points, to 84.03 on Monday. The Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index ended a provisional 12.85 points, or 0.33 percent up at 3,870.34.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market fell to 12.85 percent from 17.2 on Friday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
